data.one_liner: Run llama.cpp GGUF models on Android via a Flutter plugin
data.what_it_does: This plugin lets Flutter apps load and run llama.cpp models on Android devices. It streams generated tokens, supports GPU acceleration, and exposes full generation parameters.
use_when: Need on-device LLM inference without external APIs
Require real‑time token streaming for chat UIs
Want to leverage Vulkan GPU for faster inference
avoid_when: Need inference to survive backgrounding without a custom foreground service
Deploy very large models that exceed device RAM
strengths: Fine‑grained control of sampling, penalties, and templates
Stable streaming with guaranteed onDone termination
weaknesses: Only works on Android (iOS support missing)
Requires NDK r27+ and ARM64 ABI
No built‑in background service for long‑running inference
Setup requires proguard rules and native library handling
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, include proguard rules, ensure Android API 26+, NDK r27+, and optional GPU detection before loading model
